$description: Lumen v0.13 — EXPRESSIVE-mode noise primitives. Three SVG feTurbulence grain textures as inline data URIs. Opacity baked into the SVG itself so consumers apply via a single `background-image` declaration. Defeats banding on mesh gradients (radial-gradient stops at 10% opacity show step-banding on retina; 6–8% grain dithers it away invisibly). NEVER animate the feTurbulence filter itself (massive perf cost); animate gradient hue or stop positions instead (see mesh.tokens.json). numOctaves capped at 3 — above 4 is performance waste with no visual gain. The SVG uses `stitchTiles='stitch'` so the 100×100 tile repeats seamlessly across any background size.

subtle.$description: 6% opacity — defeats gradient banding without being visible at 1:1. The Lumen default for restrained-mode atmospheric surfaces (when a hint of grain is wanted without commitment).
